content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-costing-you-3|Why Payment]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-3|COREMERCH guide to payments]] for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Stripe operates in 46 countries, but you're not among them. Gumroad is a decent alternative, but it doesn't support your local payment methods. PayPal is available in many countries, but its account suspension policies can be harsh. Lemon Squeezy is another option, but it's not available in your region. In contrast, NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with 300+ cryptocurrencies and a 0.5% fee. It's designed for creators like you who want to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and Gumroad have strict country restrictions, which exclude many regions, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. PayPal has a more lenient approach, but its account suspension policies can still impact creators in restricted countries. NOWPayments, on the other hand, doesn't impose country restrictions, making it an attractive option for creators in these regions. With NOWPayments, you can sell presets and other digital products without worrying about country-specific limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and Gumroad charge flat fees for transactions, but their payment processing times can be slow. PayPal's fees are competitive, but its account suspension policies can result in significant losses. NOWPayments offers fast payment processing, with fees as low as 0.5% per transaction. With its low fees and fast payment processing, NOWPayments is an attractive option for creators who want to maximize their earnings. By choosing NOWPayments, you can receive payments in your preferred cryptocurrency, eliminating the need for intermediaries and their associated fees.
NOWPayments is the only payment processor that doesn't impose country restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With NOWPayments, you retain complete ownership of your digital products and payment data. You can automate your payment processing, delivery, and customer notifications using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This means you can focus on creating more presets and other digital products, while NOWPayments handles the payment processing and delivery. By choosing NOWPayments, you can ensure that your digital products are delivered securely and efficiently, without relying on traditional payment processors.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're looking for a simple, low-cost solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) might be the best option. This stack offers GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, making it an ideal choice for small creators. If you need a more robust solution with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the way to go. This stack combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, making it an excellent choice for more established creators.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
With NOWPayments, you can automate your payment processing, delivery, and customer notifications using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce stack, you need to: Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) from Shop COREMERCH. Set up your Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages hosting. Configure your Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script backend logic. Set up your Supabase or Google Sheets order storage. Configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Test your stack thoroughly before launching your digital products.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my existing payment processor?

You don't need to integrate NOWPayments with your existing payment processor. NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, eliminating the need for intermediaries and their associated fees.
Can I use NOWPayments with other e-commerce platforms?
Yes, NOWPayments can be integrated with other e-commerce platforms, such as Shopify or WooCommerce, to provide automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
How do I configure my Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages hosting?
To configure your Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages hosting, follow the instructions provided by Cloudflare or GitHub, and make sure to set up your SSL certificates and custom domain.
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) offers GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, making it an excellent choice for more established creators.
Can I use NOWPayments for other types of digital products?
Yes, NOWPayments can be used for other types of digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software, in addition to presets and other creative assets.
